$comment: The front page's plan. scripts/story/lib/lander.mts reads it, portal:build writes the page from it, scripts/test-lander.mts checks it. Authored. Every family, beat, service and app named here must exist and be current: a miss falls back with a log line, and fails the build in strict mode (a push to main). It holds no copy: every word of the page is claims.json's, a family file's or scripts/portal-front.mts's.
